exposure: Symptomatic (postmenstrual spotting) vs. asymptomatic women with a niche
cohort: 727 women who underwent cesarean section more than 1 year earlier
finding: A new definition for a large niche after cesarean section, based on the presence of postmenstrual spotting, was generated: niche depth ≥ 0.50 cm, RMT ≤ 0.21 cm, or niche depth/AMT ratio ≥ 0.56.
cross-section timing: More than 1 year after Cesarean section, during the midfollicular phase
